1.11.21: Reverted experimental Spicy Lyrics integration to restore rock-solid core stability.
1.11.20: Hotfix: Resolved a syntax error that prevented the extension from loading in version 1.11.19.
1.11.19: Improved Spicy Lyrics integration: The date pill now retains its styling in fullscreen mode and correctly anchors under the artist name when Spicy Lyrics is opened in the right sidebar.
1.11.18: Restored pill styling and positioning logic for Spicy Lyrics.
1.11.17: Fixed a bug where the date pill was completely invisible in both Spicy Lyrics main view and full screen view due to overflow clipping.
1.11.16: Fixed an issue where the date pill would appear in the wrong place in Spicy Lyrics CinemaMode. It now attaches directly to the artist metadata without pushing it up.
1.11.15: Made Spicy Lyrics fullscreen detection completely foolproof by checking for fixed CSS positioning instead of classes, and added fallback metadata selectors.
1.11.14: Fixed an issue where the extension failed to detect Spicy Lyrics fullscreen mode because Spicy Lyrics creates multiple duplicate IDs. Switched to a robust class selector.
1.11.13: Reverted Spicy Lyrics fullscreen detection to strictly rely on its native class to fix edge cases where it wasn't detected.
1.11.12: Fixed Spicy Lyrics overlay positioning getting stuck in the bottom-left corner due to conflicting CSS rules, and improved fullscreen detection by checking DOM parent.
1.11.11: Completely rewrote Spicy Lyrics integration to use an overlay system. This permanently fixes layout squishing and perfectly detects fullscreen mode without relying on fragile classes.
1.11.10: Fixed an issue where the date pill would squish the artist name in Spicy Lyrics fullscreen by moving it outside the metadata container.
1.11.9: Fixed an issue where the date pill would move when Spicy Lyrics was running in the main view instead of full screen.
1.11.8: Added seamless integration for Spicy Lyrics fullscreen mode.
1.11.7: Added dynamic Spicetify theme color options for text color.
1.11.6: Fixed an issue where the settings menu and changelog popup stayed on screen after an OTA update.
1.11.5: Renamed all internal 'nprd' prefixes to 'brd' (Beautiful Release Date).
1.11.4: Fixed a bug where the update popup would show repeatedly for some users.
1.11.3: Removed the experimental Discord Local Remote connection to resolve connection timeout issues.
1.11.2: Forced WebSockets in Socket.IO to bypass XHR mixed-content blocking.
1.11.1: Added debug toasts to figure out why the Discord button is hiding.
1.11.0: Added seamless Socket.IO connection to The Goats DJ Remote for playback control.
Injected a dynamic Discord DJ button into the Release Date UI when connected.
Reduced OTA update check cooldown from 5 minutes to 30 seconds for easier testing.
Clarified GitHub cache delay warnings in the OTA update check toast messages.
1.10.0: Merged 'Analytics' and 'Info' tabs into a single unified tab.
Fixed a bug where the update popup would show every time Spotify was restarted.
1.9.31: Fixed race conditions in the UI update functions that caused duplicated/overlapping visual elements.
1.11.22: Fixed a bug where offline cache loading would incorrectly parse null release dates as 1970-01-01 and crash the formatting.
1.11.23: Fixed a bug where the date pill would revert to Unknown Date in the middle of a song when Spicy Lyrics re-renders, caused by missing track album data during Spotify background URI updates.
1.11.24: Completely removed legacy restoreInterval code that was causing unwanted track fetches and Unknown Date bugs.
